ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_sigmoid_advantage_loss_logmeanexp_agg
ir.intuition: Maintain the pairwise sigmoid advantage loss formulation but aggregate losses using log-mean-exp to smoothly emphasize harder pairs and improve gradient signal compared to simple mean or sum.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = lpw - lpl - beta * advantage_gap
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
losses = -log(sigmoid(scaled_margin))
weighted_losses = weight * losses
loss = logsumexp(weighted_losses) - log(sum(weight))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(beta, adv))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
    if weight is None:
        weight = ops.ones_like(losses)
    weighted_losses = ops.mul(weight, losses)
    max_val = ops.max(weighted_losses)
    stabilized = ops.sub(weighted_losses, max_val)
    sum_exp = ops.sum(ops.exp(stabilized))
    sum_weights = ops.sum(weight)
    logmeanexp = ops.add(max_val, ops.sub(ops.log(sum_exp), ops.log(sum_weights)))
    return logmeanexp
